answer_1.quote: we adopt a two-phase architecture: (1) explaining numbers/variables and (2) building solution equations.
answer_1.outputs: natural language explanations for numbers/variables and solution equations

answer_2.quote: To test the plausibility of explanations, we used BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, CIDEr, and BLEURT.

answer_4.quote: we manually labeled the quality in the PEN's development set using two criteria: (1) plausibility and (2) faithfulness.
answer_4.guideline: Human coders labeled explanations based on plausibility (coherence with problem text) and faithfulness (by building solution equations using explanations and comparing to model output).
